summary: Wrote docs/features-2.md (design of six features) and this plan: 5 waves, 16 units, at most 5 per wave, disjoint ownership within a wave. Usage: songwriter::usage (Usage, ModelUsage, Generation) parsed from the CLI envelope (usage, output_tokens_details.thinking_tokens, modelUsage, total_cost_usd, duration_ms) and the API reply (model, usage); no price table, so API cost stays None; one RenderSidecar type in songwriter::sidecar replaces the two copies in the CLI and studio and keeps the generation across re-renders. Settings: the settings crate reads $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/electric-sunflowers/config.toml leniently with warnings (claude model/transport/effort, songwriter voice/duet, studio library, export ogg_quality); flag > file > default; the studio edits and saves it. Mixer: MixSettings (fader dB, pan, mute, solo per track; duck_db) with mix_with; the default path multiplies by exactly 1.0 so the mix stays bit-identical; the slapback moves into ProcessedStem; <stem>.mix.json sidecar; stems opt-in via --stems as 24-bit FLAC printed one at a time; the studio re-mixes cached stems off-thread (debounced) instead of a live mixer, because bus compression and peak normalisation need whole-song statistics. Duets: song JSON gains duet {voice, phrasing}, and sing/lead/blend on sections and lines, with repairs; compose uses a duet register fit (B's lines offset by the residual register difference, one joint transposition minimising both singers' range penalty; second voice on shared lines by harmony_line or octave); arrange adds lead_b and doubles per voice; engine adds TrackId::LeadB keyed to the ducker; lead sheet uses two staves on shared lines. Phrasing: Phrasing {delivery legato|flowing|parlando|detached, endings held|released|clipped} per song and per duet singer, style default via Style::apply; voice::phrasing maps it to sustain, onset share, consonant lead-in, vibrato, glide, swell, breath and phrase-end parameters; flowing/released equals today's constants and borrows the notes unchanged. Full score: notation::full model from the arrangement events (to_beat inverse of the timeline, sixteenth quantisation, chord merging, harp grand staff, SATB from choir voicings, standard drum-set positions), multi-staff layout with drawn F/percussion clefs, x noteheads, brackets and brace (no Bravura source on the machine), Page/Sheet API with column boxes for playback follow, part view with multi-bar rests. Sound gate: the demo has none of the new fields and the default mix is bit-identical, so scripts/gate.sh --strict must pass on the demo in every wave; wave 2 adds a duet demo and gate.sh --song duet and captures its baseline once.

- New module engine::mixset: TrackMix { gain_db: f32, pan: f32, mute: bool, solo: bool }; MixSettings { tracks: [TrackMix; N_TRACKS] (indexed by TrackId), duck_db: f32 }. MixSettings::default_for(&Stems): strip pans, 0 dB, nothing muted or soloed, duck_db = DUCK_DB. (Wave 2 adds TrackId::LeadB and duet pans -0.25/+0.25; leave a clearly named const DUET_PAN_A/B = -0.25/0.25 and a doc line, used when a LeadB exists; for now there is none.) MixSettings::audible(id): not muted, and soloed when any track is soloed. to_json(&self, defaults) -> serde_json::Value writing only what differs: {"version":1, "tracks": {"violin": {"gain_db": -3.0}, ...}, "duck_db": 4.0}; from_json(&Value, defaults) -> (MixSettings, Vec<String>) lenient: unknown track names and keys, wrong types -> warning and default; gain_db clamped to -120..=12, pan to -1..=1, duck_db to 0..=20. Track keys are TrackId::name().
- ProcessedStem gains slap: Option<SparseBuf> (the strip's slapback, gain applied, as today); Stems.slapback is removed (update render.rs Store, strip.rs run_strip, the stems example's render.json field and render_test).
- mix_with(stems, band, seed, &MixSettings) -> Stereo. Route gain = strip.gain * db_to_gain(gain_db) * level (in f32 as today: compute the fader factor as f32 and multiply so that the default path multiplies by exactly 1.0; db_to_gain(0.0) is exp(0) = 1.0 exactly: test it). Pan from settings. A track plays when id.plays(band) && settings.audible(id). The slapback of a playing track is added to main and send at gain db_to_gain(gain_db) (unity by default, unpanned, as today). mix(stems, band, seed) = mix_with(stems, band, seed, &MixSettings::default_for(stems)).
- Ducking: duck_gains(stems, band, &MixSettings) keyed by the post-fader power of the audible lead tracks (today only Lead; write it as a loop over the lead tracks so wave 2 adds LeadB in one line); lead tracks are never ducked; depth settings.duck_db; duck_db == 0 returns None (no ducker). Keep the full-scale point (0.5 * TARGET_RMS * lead strip gain * level) and the time constants. Keep a shim duck_gains(stems, band) for examples/balance.rs or update balance.rs.
- New module engine::print (stem printing, features-2 3.3): mix_gain(stems, band, seed, &MixSettings) -> f32 (the final peak-normalisation factor of the full mix: run mix_with's pre-normalisation path and return PEAK / peak; refactor mix_with into a private function that returns the pre-normalisation stereo and the gain, so both share one code path); print_stem(stems, band, seed, &MixSettings, id, duck: Option<&[f32]>, gain: f32) -> Option<Stereo> = one track as it enters the main bus (post fader, post pan, ducked, its slapback included, dry) times gain; print_reverb(...) -> Stereo = the FDN return of the send bus of all audible tracks times gain. One stem at a time so peak memory is one stereo stem plus the duck track. The bus compressor is not applied to printed stems; document it: sum of printed stems + reverb == the pre-compressor mix * gain.
- Sound: the default mix must be bit-identical to today. Keep a verbatim copy of today's mix function (and today's duck_gains) in crates/engine/tests/mixer.rs as the reference and assert bit equality for 3 seeds of the demo.
Tests in crates/engine/tests/mixer.rs: bit identity above; muting a non-lead track == switching its band part off (bits equal); solo of one band track == muting all others; duck_db 0 == a mix where duck_gains returns None; +6 dB fader multiplies the route gain by exactly db_to_gain(6.0) as f32 (test the route builder); to_json/from_json round trip and lenient reading; printed stems + reverb, summed, equal the pre-compressor mix times the gain within 1e-5 of its peak (demo, one seed); print_stem of a muted track is None.

1. compose::timeline: pub fn to_beat(&self, t: f64) -> f64, the inverse of to_time: binary search on self.t, linear inside a beat, and the same linear rules as to_time before the start and past the end (ritard kept). 2. notation Cargo.toml: add arrange = { path = "../arrange" } (arrange has no audio dependency).
3. New module notation::full (pub mod full in lib.rs; files crates/notation/src/full/mod.rs and model.rs):
   - PartId { Lead, LeadB, Harmony, Doubles, ChoirS, ChoirA, ChoirT, ChoirB, Violin, Guitar, HarmonyGuitar, HarpUpper, HarpLower, Bass, Drums } in this (score) order; Clef { Treble, Treble8vb, Bass, Bass8vb, Percussion } (Bass8vb: written an octave above the sound, for the bass part); Group { Vocals, Choir, Band, Harp, Drums } (brackets; Harp uses a brace); StaffDef { part, name, abbrev, clef, group }. Names/abbrevs: Voice (A)/Voc., Voice B/Voc. B, Harmony/Hrm., Doubles/Dbl., Soprano/S., Alto/A., Tenor/T., Bass/B., Violin/Vln., Guitar/Gtr., Harmony guitar/H.Gtr., Harp/Hp., Bass/Bs., Drums/Dr.
   - Sources (features-2 6.1): Lead = Vocals.lead notes; LeadB = none yet (wave 3 adds Vocals.lead_b; leave the enum value and a TODO-free doc line saying the source arrives with the duet arrangement); Harmony = Vocals.harmony; Doubles = Vocals.doubles[0]; choir S A T B = arrange::choir::voicings over the same sections vocals::choir_singers uses (read that function; reuse its predicate, in beats, not the humanised singers); Violin = Arrangement.violin; Guitar = the six StringNote lists; HarmonyGuitar = harmony_guitar.lead and .arp; HarpUpper/HarpLower = Arrangement.harp split at MIDI 60 (>= 60 upper); Bass = Arrangement.bass; Drums = Arrangement.drums (two voices: up = everything but Kick, down = Kick).

Clefs: vocal staves by the singer's voice (Treble8vb for bass, baritone, tenor; Treble otherwise); ChoirT Treble8vb; ChoirB Bass; Violin Treble; guitars Treble8vb; HarpUpper Treble, HarpLower Bass; Bass Bass8vb; Drums Percussion.
   - Quantisation (features-2 6.2): seconds -> beats with Timeline::to_beat, beats -> sixteenth units with the lead sheet's Grid (make Grid::of and Grid::split pub(crate) in score.rs; that visibility change is the only edit allowed in score.rs, and the lead sheet output must not change). 1. B relative to A: delta = centre(B) - centre(A) (VocalRange::centre, semitones); o = round(delta / 12) clamped to -1..=1; d = clamp(delta - 12 o, -5, 5). Baritone/alto: delta 10, o 1, d -2. Solo songs: no B, nothing below applies.
2. FormLine gains part: Part (copied from the song line; repeats copy it). compose_melody: LineKey gains the melody singer; a line whose melody singer is B gets LineSpec.center += d; every LeadNote gains singer: SingerId (the melody singer); after composition B's melody notes (and grace) get + 12 o.
3. choose_transpose_duet: refactor choose_transpose into range_penalty(notes_midi, voice, t) (3 per semitone of the 5th/95th percentile outside the range, 0.8 per semitone of the median from the centre) plus the octave term 0.55 per semitone of t from a whole octave; duet cost(t) = sum over singers of share_s * range_penalty(notes of s, voice_s, t) + octave term, share_s = that singer's share of melody notes; t in -30..=30, first minimum wins. The solo path must return exactly today's value for every input (keep a verbatim copy of today's function in the tests and compare over the demo in all keys and 100 seeds; compose_once_equals_two_passes must still pass unchanged).

   The demo song, 8 seeds, mean LTAS against tests/soundgate/baseline-mean/, plus per-seed 0.5/1 dB against tests/soundgate/baseline/ for seeds 1234 and 2718, vowel distance, Helmholtz, perf (reported; fails only above +50% of the first pass row), thread invariance.
